description: Evaluate an agent counterparty before an irreversible economic action such as paying, hiring, delegating, releasing escrow, or granting rights. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW, or DENY with evidence and confidence. REVIEW means evidence is insufficient for an automatic decision.

action.description: Planned economic action, for example pay, hire, delegate, release_escrow, or grant_rights.

currency.description: Currency or asset symbol, e.g. USDC.

name: trust_before_action
